If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.

SYNTH_STRATEGY: delay-oriented ABC script. Measured on the SRAM-macro design (2026-10-17): AREA 0 gave -0.74 ns slow-corner setup slack, DELAY 1 +0.65 ns, DELAY 4 +1.37 ns (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-fetch-loop-timing-design.md section 3).
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

Absolute die size
SRAM instruction memory: one IHP 512x16 single-port macro from the PDK (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-sram-imem-design.md).
Stripe grid chosen so the tile's Metal4 VPWR/VGND stripes land on the macro's Metal4 supply columns for a macro at x = 12.
FP_PDN_VOFFSET is measured from the core origin x = 2.88 (template margins) to the stripe centre: VPWR centres at 29.24 + 67.44k, VGND at 34.86 + 67.44k.

The alignment window is only 0.04 um wide because the macro's column pitch breaks from 67.44 to 68.11 across the centre VDD! bank, so the macro x, the margins and the pitch may not move independently.

pdn_cfg.tcl is Loom's (LibreLane default minus the macro grid, plus a pdngen wrapper): the macro is PLACED, not FIXED, while pdngen builds shapes so the stripes above run full height through its supply columns, and GeneratePDN fails if a stripe over the macro misses a same-net column or a macro supply pin gets no stripe.
Magic flags the tile stripes crossing the LEF's Metal4 OBS bar at the VDD!/VDDARRAY! split; the GDS has no metal there. KLayout DRC (precheck) and LVS remain the gate.
